decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1		A1A	The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - 1		B5	The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - 1		NON-STD	The applicant shall obtain planning permission to upgrade the existing kitchen extraction system within six months of the date of this permission.  The applicant shall contact Council's Pollution Control Team for details of an acceptable extraction system, and the system shall be designed in accordance with the details.

Condition : 5 - 1		NON-STD	The premises shall be fitted with a property maintained fat trap in line with the leaflet 'Best Management Practices for Catering Establishments', which can be obtained by phoning 020 8507 4321.
Condition : 6 - 1		NON-STD	The hours of operation are hereby restricted to 8:00am to 5:00pm Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 6:00pm Saturday, and 9:00am to 6:00pm Sunday and Bank Holidays.
description: Change of use from A1 (retail) to A3 Cafe.
